

## Solution

This is a POC repo for the agentic life insurer

Read all the markdown files in the docs folder to understand the project structure and documentation.



## Rules
minimal output for logging and description of the code changes
don't include any markdown files
don't include any unit test
keep the code as readable and simple as possible
never include any business name or application name from customer
make sure remove any sensitive information in mock data


## Workaround
add SecurityControl=Ignore to AI Seach and also enable public access
add SecurityControl=Ignore to storage account and also enable public access
